card.name: Folding Fan
card.subject: An open hand fan with a half-circle of thin ribs joined at a pivot at the bottom and fabric stretched between them.
card.hero_colors: pale pink silk with an ivory lace edge, ivory ribs, gold pivot
card.note: A European lady's fan of the 1800s, pale pink with a lace edge. It is opened evenly, both outer sticks at the same height, and its pleats fold in and out.
